item.title: How to change the user in Subversive (Eclipse SVN)
item.description:
Today we’ll learn how to change the user logged into Subversive, the Eclipse IDE plugin. Well, this guide can also be useful if you’ve changed or lost your username and/or password and can’t authenticate with the SVN Server. Unfortunately this plugin doesn’t provide a graphical interface so you can simply log off and log in again.

However, we can do this very simply. Anyway, enough rambling, let’s get straight to what matters.

item.title: Installing ZeosLib in Delphi XE2
item.description:
After having difficulty installing ZeosLib in Delphi XE2, I decided to share “the way through”.

The ZeosLib Library

The ZeosLib library consists of a set of tools so you can have a native database connection, meaning a connection without auxiliary drivers such as ODBC.

ZeosLib is an open-source project, its installation isn’t that complex, but here’s the recipe, just follow the steps without skipping “any ingredient”.

Downloading the ZeosLib Library
